title: Mall World in Bad Decline
content: For years I have been having MallWorld type scenerio dreams only everything is falling apart. Empty stores selling weird shit... a Starbucks where the logo looks normal at a distance but as you get closer its just the mermaid sloppily colored in green crayon on pieces of paper taped together; the counter was splintery plywood covered in gray paint. Also a WholeFoods market where most shelves were empty and food was packaged in generic blue-gray cardboard and the seafood counter was just a few tiny tropical-looking fish laid out on the ice. I can't tell if this is a hint of collapse or capitalism completely unwound. &#x200B;
